name: @ottabase/context
description: The otta-context schema, version 2: one JSON file that says what a product is, in the shape Ottabase apps serve at /.well-known/otta.json, Ottabuzz serves as context.json and Imageine imports. Types, a clamping defineProduct, the writer, the lenient reader, a founder manifest, a content hash, and a fetch that knows when a file changed. No dependencies, runs in a Worker, Node and the browser.
